newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor June prices slide on slow demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor June prices slide on slow demand.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Thursday slid further to 1,100/1,101 rupees per quintal from 1,104/1,105 rupees on fresh speculative offerings, dealers said.
"Higher arrivals of castorseed from producing centres and sluggish export demand dragged down prices," a dealer said.
Daily arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region remained higher at 30,000 bags (75 kg each).
Dealers said foreign buyers seeking Indian castoroil at 690 dollars per tonne while sellers were at 705/710 dollars.
